nodes.label: AgentVoca
nodes.rationale: Developer-first, model-agnostic voice dictation desktop app for macOS and Windows. Pairs any ASR provider with any cleanup/LLM provider; result inserted directly at the cursor in the active app.

nodes.label: Observer Mode (v0.4.0)
nodes.rationale: Background session recorder capturing microphone + keyframes + selections, compiled to a readable markdown document and a v0.5.0-facing JSON sidecar.

nodes.label: Observer Session Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Toggle hotkey to start, work normally, pause on exclusion/pause hotkey, toggle to stop, compile on the asyncio loop. DB at ~/.agentvoca/observer/sessions.db; blobs and exports under that dir.

nodes.label: Four Keyframe Triggers
nodes.rationale: window_change, scroll_settle, click_selection, speech_onset — each individually toggleable. Token bucket caps at 4/min; min interval 4s. speech_onset (D9) grounds an utterance to a screen and is the most valuable trigger for the v0.5.0 Agent.

nodes.label: Observer Privacy & Consent
nodes.rationale: Off by default; persistent visible indicator; exclusion list (apps + window titles); pause/resume hotkey; 7-day retention purge; local by default. D12 caveat: no encryption, plaintext under user-only ACL — defends against other accounts, not malware-as-user or stolen drives.

nodes.label: Observer Crash Recovery
nodes.rationale: Sessions left status='open' by a crashed process are recovered on next launch with a non-modal dialog offering Compile / Keep for later / Delete.

nodes.label: Observer Resource Budget
nodes.rationale: <5% idle CPU, <400MB RSS, ≤4 keyframes/min, audio callback p99 <5ms, <40MB disk/hour. If budget is breached, reduce capture rate — never exceed the budget.

nodes.label: Observer Compile Providers
nodes.rationale: rules is offline (default) and produces structured markdown with Said/Highlighted/On screen sections; openai_compatible runs per-block narrative in parallel plus a session summary, degrading to rules for any block whose LLM call fails (degraded=True); none is a raw chronological dump.

nodes.label: speech_onset Trigger (D9)
nodes.rationale: The trigger that grounds an utterance to a screen. On by default; turning it off roughly halves the keyframe rate. The most valuable trigger for the v0.5.0 Agent.

nodes.label: Latency Budgets (v2)
nodes.rationale: First partial visible ≤500ms after first speech; key-up → final inserted ≤800ms; cold-start penalty 0 (amortized at startup via warm_up); cleanup tail ≤40% of v1; audio callback p99 ≤5ms; streaming-ASR memory churn bounded by window (window_s * sample_rate * 4B per partial).

nodes.label: v0.3.6 Performance Optimizations (R2–R6)
nodes.rationale: R2: dedicated VAD worker thread off the audio callback. R3: defer finalization off the audio thread. R4: memoryview + single .copy() for the streaming window. R5: chunker _get_delta deletes emitted bytes (del self._buffer[:end]). R6: cancel wired to in-flight pipeline task via Orchestrator.cancel().

nodes.label: Benchmark Harness (scripts/benchmark.py)
nodes.rationale: scripts/benchmark.py — mock mode enforces MOCK_BUDGETS_MS budgets and is CI-gated; real mode uses faster_whisper+rules over WAV fixtures in tests/fixtures/audio/ and reports only. Mock exists to catch gross regressions in pipeline glue, not to micro-benchmark.

nodes.label: Vision Anchor Phrases
nodes.rationale: Built-ins: 'the attached screenshot', 'this screenshot', 'as shown', etc. Multiple snips map to multiple anchors in capture order; leftover appends at end. Spoken words double as the extraction instruction (e.g. 'make a table' yields markdown).

nodes.label: Local VLM (GOT-OCR 2.0) — Planned
nodes.rationale: v3 ships API-only. A future release adds an in-process local VLM similar to how faster-whisper runs ASR offline, with GOT-OCR 2.0 as the default download — compact, document-focused, images to markdown/LaTeX tables.

nodes.label: Hot-Reload vs Restart
nodes.rationale: Hot-applied: cleanup provider/style, hotkeys, vocab & snippets, adaptive vocab, context profiles, voice commands, vision anchors/output_format. Requires restart: ASR provider/model, audio device/sample rate/VAD, insertion strategy, vision enable/provider, app mode/language/profile, debug logging.

nodes.label: audio config section
nodes.rationale: sample_rate must be in [8000, 48000]; silence_timeout_ms must be > 0; vad_enabled drives silero-vad silence detection for auto-stop.

nodes.label: asr config section
nodes.rationale: Provider required (faster_whisper, openai_compatible). streaming_chunk_ms must be in [100, 2000]. streaming_model if set must be one of tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3. If endpoint+api_key_env set, the named env var must be present at startup.

nodes.label: hotkeys config section
nodes.rationale: Must match supported hotkey syntax. Modifiers: ctrl, alt, shift, cmd (macOS), win (Windows). All keys registered system-wide via pynput.

nodes.label: adaptive config (v2)
nodes.rationale: promote_threshold must be >= 2: a single correction is too noisy, two is a learned mapping.

nodes.label: observer config (v0.4.0)
nodes.rationale: Block is fully additive — an existing config.yaml without an observer: key loads unchanged with enabled = false. retention_days=0 disables purge; max_session_mb 1..10000; dedup_phash_distance 0..32 (0 disables).

nodes.label: CI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on push/PR to main. Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 matrix. Installs libportaudio2 (sounddevice), xvfb (headless X for Qt tests), Qt6 runtime deps, uv sync --dev, ruff check + ruff format --check, pytest under xvfb-run, scripts/benchmark.py --mode mock, uploads benchmark-report.json artifact. CI has no GPU so it measures orchestration overhead, not real-model latency.

nodes.label: invalid_hotkey.yaml fixture
nodes.rationale: Tests hotkey validation rule: hotkeys.toggle_recording must match supported hotkey syntax.

nodes.label: invalid_sample_rate.yaml fixture
nodes.rationale: Tests audio.sample_rate validation: 96000 fails the [8000, 48000] constraint.

nodes.label: invalid_silence_timeout.yaml fixture
nodes.rationale: Tests audio.silence_timeout_ms validation: -100 fails the > 0 constraint.

nodes.label: missing_required.yaml fixture
nodes.rationale: Tests that asr.provider is required at startup.

nodes.label: valid_full.yaml fixture
nodes.rationale: Valid reference fixture exercising app, audio, asr (openai_compatible whisper-1), cleanup (openai_compatible gpt-4o-mini), insertion, hotkeys, vocabulary, and snippets.

nodes.label: Token Bucket Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: Design pattern used by observer.triggers.max_keyframes_per_min (default 4/min) plus min_interval_ms (default 4s) to hold per-minute keyframe count within the resource budget. If keyframe rate is too high, the right knob to turn is the bucket size, not a trigger.

nodes.label: Visible Consent Surface
nodes.rationale: Design principle: a non-dismissable on-screen badge and a red tray icon are visible for the entire session — the user can never forget it is on. Pairs with off-by-default so the indicator appears only after explicit consent.

nodes.label: Dedicated VAD Worker Thread (R2)
nodes.rationale: Mechanism: silero VAD inference runs on a dedicated daemon thread (agentvoca-vad); the sounddevice audio callback only enqueues a tuple and reads a cached bool. Enforced by tests/unit/test_capture_vad_worker.py::test_callback_p99_under_5ms_with_slow_inference. Fixes the OBS-0 bug: app.mode: auto_stop had silently never worked since v0.3.0 because VAD inference was running inline in the audio callback.

nodes.label: v0.3.6 Agent 2 I/O, Text & Startup Plan
R1: Delete duplicate VAD inference in audio callback
R2: Move VAD inference off audio callback via dedicated worker thread
R3: Move stop_recording buffer join off the audio callback
R4: O(N) streaming ASR window snapshot via memoryview
R5: Compact AudioChunker._buffer after each delta emission
R6: Wire Orchestrator.cancel() to cancel hotkey
R8: Persistent httpx.AsyncClient for cleanup + vision providers
R9: Cache custom_prompt_path with mtime check
R10: Parallelize multi-screenshot vision extraction via asyncio.gather
R11: One shared single-worker input executor for pyautogui/pyperclip
R12: O(1) casing lookup in VocabularyDictionary._replacement
R13: Bulk add_mappings() API for learned vocabulary merges
R14: Lazy provider imports via dotted-path registry
D1: RapidOCR ONNX local default for OCR
D5: Read-only UI Automation TextPattern for selection
D8: Dictation coexists with Observer session
D10: Reuse configured ASR model across dictation and ambient
D12: No encryption at rest; user-only ACL only
OBS-0: Wire VAD into AudioCapture (pre-existing bug fix)
Mic fan-out (D8) — shared mic between dictation and ambient
